essence: Every task carries an expected outcome (set before it starts) and a complete 0-1 (percentage of complete subtasks when it has subtasks); tasks render() their own View, have an on-demand tasks List, carry git commit refs, a priority, and are registered to a session but may live in a module or on a page. AITask and AISession should use this Task, not be Pages. This task system is the mechanism that tracks progress, so sessions piggyback on their tasks.
